_comment: Budgets the backdrop registry and the app's first download must stay inside (#243). Raised only with a reason in the commit message: a budget nobody defends is a number that drifts. Measured by scripts/backdrops/check-budgets.mjs against the built artifact, so they are facts about what a player downloads, not intentions.

initialCode._comment: Entry chunk plus CSS and anything statically imported with it — the script a browser must run before the app appears. Images are budgeted separately below, because gzip means nothing for a PNG.

initialImages._comment: Images the browser must fetch before the app appears. One is legitimate: the title screen's own background. Anything else — an atlas, a backdrop, a map — belongs behind the screen that needs it.
initialImages._maxBackdropImagesNote: Hard zero. A backdrop is chosen from the world, so none may ride in before the world has been read.

registryChunk._comment: The manifest itself: must be a dynamic import, never part of the initial payload.

images._comment: Per-image ceilings, read from the committed manifest so they hold even where the PNGs are deferred out of history.
